name: A mineral interior / changing optical surface
art: The internal field is an original fragment shader. Its architecture and look are explicitly separate from the reference collection's licensed shader implementations.

properties.label: Crisp sphere-like optical silhouette
properties.text: Use one crisp fixed spherical limb with fine field detail compressed toward its edge.

properties.label: Blue-green, pale gold and violet
properties.text: Combine warm ivory #ebebe1, deep green and muted green-gray with dark blue-green regions, pale golden filaments and subtle violet clouding.

properties.label: Dense procedural mineral field
properties.text: Construct an internal-looking projected optical field with original procedural turbulence, coherent density and fine filamentary detail. It is a procedural surface study, not arbitrary DOM refraction or a measured volumetric simulation.

properties.label: Large orb on an airy editorial stage
properties.text: Place one very large focal graphic in the main field, with a quiet editorial statement at left, ample open space and compact atmosphere, excitation and pause controls along the lower edge.

properties.label: Slow coherent field evolution
properties.text: Evolve the internal procedural field slowly and coherently inside a fixed boundary. Reduced motion, paused playback and matching posters retain an intentional composed state.

properties.label: Large sans statement with serif emphasis
properties.text: Set a large, tightly tracked two-line sans statement with one restrained Instrument Serif emphasis, a small mono eyebrow and a quiet supporting paragraph.

properties.label: Directional sheen and cyan edge light
properties.text: Use directional form light, a tight view-sensitive pale sheen, a restrained cyan edge contribution and a narrow pale boundary highlight so the focal surface stays dimensional without turning into a bright white rim.

properties.label: Atmosphere, excitation and orientation controls
properties.text: Lagoon, Violet and Ember select distinct palettes; Excitation changes luminous energy; pointer position shifts field orientation; and Pause or Resume controls the evolution. Keep every control keyboard and touch operable.

properties.label: Optical field quality check
properties.text: Compare boundary sharpness, highlight placement, dense-versus-open regions and color relationships. Reject a flat painted disc, simple CSS blur bubble or bright white rim that erases the material.

properties.label: Stable plasma extremes
properties.text: Test parameter extremes and temporal stability.
